scenarios.title: A｜向酒店求助
scenarios.setting: 在“身体不舒服”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“向酒店求助”。

turns.prompt: 你想向酒店说明身体不适，并请求帮助，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’m not feeling well. Could you help me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m not feeling well. Could you help me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’m feeling quite sick. Is there someone who can help me?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m feeling quite sick. Is there someone who can help me?
feedback.explanation: 从自己的感受说明影响，把需要讨论的重点说出来，避免直接替对方判断动机。

choices.text: I’m not feeling well and I’m not sure what to do.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not feeling well and I’m not sure what to do.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

choices.text: I feel a little dizzy. Could I get some help?

feedback.naturalExpression: I feel a little dizzy. Could I get some help?
feedback.explanation: “dizzy”指头晕的，描述当下不适。

choices.text: My body feels very bad.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m not feeling well. Could you help me?
feedback.explanation: 身体不适通常说“I’m not feeling well”；“my body feels bad”笼统且不太地道。

turns.text: Of course. Are you able to come down to the front desk?

turns.prompt: 关于「身体不舒服」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, I can come downstairs.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I can come downstairs.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I’d rather stay in my room if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather stay in my room if possible.
feedback.explanation: “stay in”指待在家、不外出，适合聊休闲偏好。

choices.text: I’m feeling too weak to come downstairs.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m feeling too weak to come downstairs.
feedback.explanation: 从自己的感受说明影响，把需要讨论的重点说出来，避免直接替对方判断动机。

choices.text: I think I need someone to come to my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I need someone to come to my room.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

turns.text: We can send a staff member up to check on you. If necessary, we can also call for medical assistance.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. I’d appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’d appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: Yes, please. I’m in room 806.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, please. I’m in room 806.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: I think I may need medical help.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I may need medical help.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

scenarios.title: B｜询问附近药店 / 医院
scenarios.setting: 在“身体不舒服”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问附近药店 / 医院”。

turns.prompt: 你想寻找附近仍在营业的药店，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is there a pharmacy nearby that’s still open?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a pharmacy nearby that’s still open?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Where’s the nearest pharmacy?

feedback.naturalExpression: Where’s the nearest pharmacy?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的信息限定为地点或位置，适合请人指路或定位物品。

choices.text: Is there a hospital or clinic near the hotel?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a hospital or clinic near the hotel?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Do you know where I can get medical help nearby?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know where I can get medical help nearby?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Where can I buy some medicine?

feedback.naturalExpression: Where can I buy some medicine?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

turns.text: There’s a pharmacy about five minutes away, and there’s a clinic two blocks from here.

turns.prompt: 你想了解时间安排或需要等多久，会怎么问？

choices.text: Do you know what time the pharmacy closes?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know what time the pharmacy closes?
feedback.explanation: “What time”请对方给出具体时点，适合确认开始、结束或赴约时间。

choices.text: Is the clinic open now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the clinic open now?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Can I walk there from the hotel?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I walk there from the hotel?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Which one would be easier to get to by taxi?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which one would be easier to get to by taxi?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

turns.text: The pharmacy closes at ten. The clinic is open 24 hours.

turns.prompt: 你想请对方帮助确认诊所的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you show me where the clinic is?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you show me where the clinic is?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Could you write down the address for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you write down the address for me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Could you call a taxi to take me there?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you call a taxi to take me there?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Great. I’ll go to the pharmacy first. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll go to the pharmacy first. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜请酒店联系医生
scenarios.setting: 在“身体不舒服”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“请酒店联系医生”。

turns.prompt: 你想请酒店帮助联系医生，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you help me contact a doctor?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you help me contact a doctor?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is there a doctor the hotel can call?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a doctor the hotel can call?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Could you arrange for a doctor to come to the hotel?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you arrange for a doctor to come to the hotel?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’d like to speak to a doctor, if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to speak to a doctor, if possible.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Can you find a doctor for me?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could you help me contact a doctor?
feedback.explanation: 这句可以自然请求帮助；“help me contact a doctor”更明确是希望对方协助联系，而不只是寻找。

turns.text: Yes. We can contact an on-call doctor. Could you briefly tell me what’s wrong?

turns.prompt: 你想说说自己的感受或状态，会怎么表达？

choices.text: I’ve been feeling sick since this afternoon.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been feeling sick since this afternoon.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: I have a bad headache and feel dizzy.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have a bad headache and feel dizzy.
feedback.explanation: “headache”指头痛，描述感受而不直接判断病因。

choices.text: I’ve been vomiting and don’t feel well enough to go out.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been vomiting and don’t feel well enough to go out.
feedback.explanation: “don’t feel well”是身体不适的常用说法，后面可以接具体症状。

choices.text: I’d rather explain the details directly to the doctor.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather explain the details directly to the doctor.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

turns.text: Of course. The doctor can usually be here within an hour.

turns.prompt: 你想了解这项服务的费用，会怎么问？

choices.text: Do you know how much the visit will cost?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know how much the visit will cost?
feedback.explanation: “How much”可问金额或不可数事物的量；这里把所需数额直接作为问题重点。

choices.text: Will I need to pay the doctor directly?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I need to pay the doctor directly?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Could you ask the doctor to come as soon as possible?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you ask the doctor to come as soon as possible?
feedback.explanation: “as soon as possible”表示尽快，说明事情紧急，但没有指定一个确定时点。

choices.text: An hour is okay. Please arrange the visit.

feedback.naturalExpression: An hour is okay. Please arrange the visit.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

turns.text: Certainly. We’ll contact the doctor now.

turns.prompt: 告诉对方你的房间号，方便对方处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. I’ll be in room 806.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’ll be in room 806.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Thanks. Please call me when the doctor arrives.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Please call me when the doctor arrives.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。
